integrity: The count of one-direction illuminated vertices and both illumination optima follow from the strict facet criterion, cyclic-minimum lemma, explicit partition, and vertex-incidence double count. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Full equality with the type-A braid normal fan is essential; coarsened fans are not classified. Historical priority is provisional. Finite exact checks do not establish the all-dimensional theorem; that rests on the analytic proof.
title: Exact ordinary and fractional illumination of full braid-fan polytopes
